overview: The Meriva Collection stands as a testament to sophisticated coastal living, representing Ellington Properties' vision of creating an exclusive beachfront sanctuary within Dubai's prestigious Dubai Islands. This exceptional residential development transcends traditional apartment living by offering an intimate, low-density island community where contemporary luxury meets serene waterfront tranquility. With its distinctive architectural approach and uncompromising attention to detail, The Meriva Collection delivers an unparalleled lifestyle experience that seamlessly blends privacy, elegance, and direct access to pristine beaches.
